waygate:settings.nameHelp.vi: Bắt đầu bằng chữ cái Latin hoặc chữ số, tối đa 63 ký tự
waygate:settings.nameHelp.bn: ইংরেজি অক্ষর বা সংখ্যা দিয়ে শুরু করুন, সর্বোচ্চ ৬৩ অক্ষর

waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.ko: 비워두면 자동 생성됩니다. 영문/숫자로 시작, 최대 63자
waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.en: Generated automatically if left blank. Start with a letter or number, up to 63 characters
waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.ja: 空欄の場合は自動生成されます。英字・数字で始まり、最大63文字
waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.zh-CN: 留空时自动生成。以英文字母或数字开头，最多 63 个字符
waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.sw: Litazalishwa kiotomatiki ukiacha wazi. Anza kwa herufi au nambari, hadi vibambo 63
waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.nb: Genereres automatisk hvis feltet er tomt. Start med en bokstav eller et tall, opptil 63 tegn
waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.ms: Dijana secara automatik jika dibiarkan kosong. Mulakan dengan huruf atau nombor, sehingga 63 aksara
waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.vi: Tự động tạo nếu để trống. Bắt đầu bằng chữ cái Latin hoặc chữ số, tối đa 63 ký tự
waygate:settings.nameHelpAutomatic.bn: খালি রাখলে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে তৈরি হবে। ইংরেজি অক্ষর বা সংখ্যা দিয়ে শুরু করুন, সর্বোচ্চ ৬৩ অক্ষর

waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.ko: 사전 공유 키(PSK): 없음 · 기존 연결이 끊기지 않도록 자동으로 추가하지 않습니다.
waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.en: Pre-shared key (PSK): None · Not added automatically to avoid interrupting existing connections.
waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.ja: 事前共有鍵（PSK）：なし · 既存の接続が切れないよう、自動では追加しません。
waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.zh-CN: 预共享密钥（PSK）：无 · 为避免中断现有连接，不会自动添加。
waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.sw: Ufunguo ulioshirikiwa mapema (PSK): Hakuna · Hauongezwi kiotomatiki ili kuepuka kukatiza miunganisho iliyopo.
waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.nb: Forhåndsdelt nøkkel (PSK): Ingen · Legges ikke til automatisk for å unngå å avbryte eksisterende tilkoblinger.
waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.ms: Kunci prakongsi (PSK): Tiada · Tidak ditambahkan secara automatik untuk mengelakkan gangguan sambungan sedia ada.
waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.vi: Khóa chia sẻ trước (PSK): Không có · Không tự động thêm để tránh làm gián đoạn các kết nối hiện có.
waygate:settings.pskDisabledHelp.bn: প্রি-শেয়ার্ড কী (PSK): নেই · বিদ্যমান সংযোগে বিঘ্ন এড়াতে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে যোগ করা হয় না।

waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.ko: 사전 공유 키(PSK): 사용 중 · 저장 시 기존 키를 유지합니다.
waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.en: Pre-shared key (PSK): In use · The existing key is preserved when saving.
waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.ja: 事前共有鍵（PSK）：使用中 · 保存時に既存の鍵を維持します。
waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.zh-CN: 预共享密钥（PSK）：使用中 · 保存时保留现有密钥。
waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.sw: Ufunguo ulioshirikiwa mapema (PSK): Unatumika · Ufunguo uliopo huhifadhiwa wakati wa kuhifadhi.
waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.nb: Forhåndsdelt nøkkel (PSK): I bruk · Den eksisterende nøkkelen beholdes ved lagring.
waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.ms: Kunci prakongsi (PSK): Sedang digunakan · Kunci sedia ada dikekalkan semasa menyimpan.
waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.vi: Khóa chia sẻ trước (PSK): Đang sử dụng · Khóa hiện có được giữ nguyên khi lưu.
waygate:settings.pskEnabledHelp.bn: প্রি-শেয়ার্ড কী (PSK): ব্যবহৃত হচ্ছে · সংরক্ষণের সময় বিদ্যমান কী অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.ko: 저장한 값은 이 기기에 설정을 다시 가져와야 적용됩니다. 저장 후 .conf를 다시 받거나 QR을 다시 스캔하세요.
waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.en: Saved values take effect only after importing the configuration again on this device. After saving, download the .conf again or scan the QR again.
waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.ja: 保存した値は、このデバイスで設定を再度取り込むと反映されます。保存後、.confを再取得するか、QRを再度スキャンしてください。
waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.zh-CN: 保存的值需要在此设备上重新导入配置后才会生效。保存后，请重新下载 .conf 或重新扫描 QR。
waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.sw: Thamani zilizohifadhiwa huanza kutumika tu baada ya kuleta usanidi tena kwenye kifaa hiki. Baada ya kuhifadhi, pakua .conf tena au changanua QR tena.
waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.nb: Lagrede verdier trer først i kraft når konfigurasjonen importeres på nytt på denne enheten. Etter lagring må du laste ned .conf på nytt eller skanne QR-koden på nytt.
waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.ms: Nilai yang disimpan hanya berkuat kuasa selepas mengimport semula konfigurasi pada peranti ini. Selepas menyimpan, muat turun .conf sekali lagi atau imbas QR sekali lagi.
waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.vi: Các giá trị đã lưu chỉ có hiệu lực sau khi nhập lại cấu hình trên thiết bị này. Sau khi lưu, hãy tải xuống lại .conf hoặc quét lại mã QR.
waygate:settings.savedSettingsHelp.bn: এই ডিভাইসে কনফিগারেশন আবার ইমপোর্ট করলেই সংরক্ষিত মান কার্যকর হবে। সংরক্ষণের পর .conf আবার ডাউনলোড করুন বা QR আবার স্ক্যান করুন।

waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.ko: 상속 중인 클라이언트와 새 클라이언트의 DNS·Keepalive 기본값입니다. 직접 지정한 값은 유지됩니다. 변경 후 기기에서 .conf 또는 QR을 다시 가져오세요.
waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.en: Default DNS and Keepalive values for clients using inheritance and new clients. Custom values are preserved. After changing them, import the .conf or QR again on the device.
waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.ja: 継承中のクライアントと新しいクライアントのDNS・Keepaliveのデフォルト値です。個別に指定した値は維持されます。変更後、デバイスで.confまたはQRを再度取り込んでください。
waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.zh-CN: 这是继承默认值的客户端和新客户端的 DNS·Keepalive 默认值。自定义值将保留。更改后，请在设备上重新导入 .conf 或 QR。
waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.sw: Thamani chaguomsingi za DNS na za kudumisha muunganisho kwa wateja wanaotumia urithi wa mipangilio na wateja wapya. Thamani maalumu huhifadhiwa. Baada ya kuzibadilisha, leta tena .conf au QR kwenye kifaa.
waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.nb: Standardverdier for DNS og Keepalive for klienter som bruker arv, og for nye klienter. Egendefinerte verdier beholdes. Etter endringer må du importere .conf eller QR-koden på nytt på enheten.
waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.ms: Nilai DNS dan Keepalive lalai untuk klien yang menggunakan pewarisan dan klien baharu. Nilai tersuai dikekalkan. Selepas mengubahnya, import .conf atau QR sekali lagi pada peranti.
waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.vi: Các giá trị DNS và Keepalive mặc định cho máy khách sử dụng tính năng kế thừa và máy khách mới. Các giá trị tùy chỉnh được giữ nguyên. Sau khi thay đổi, hãy nhập lại .conf hoặc mã QR trên thiết bị.
waygate:settings.serverDefaultsHelp.bn: সার্ভারের ডিফল্ট মান অনুসরণকারী এবং নতুন ক্লায়েন্টগুলোর জন্য ডিফল্ট DNS ও Keepalive মান। নিজস্ব মানগুলো অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। পরিবর্তনের পর ডিভাইসে .conf বা QR আবার ইমপোর্ট করুন।

waygate:traffic.ariaLabel.ja: {name}のクライアント側トラフィック

waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.ko: 최근 보고 · 다음 보고 후 속도 계산
waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.en: Recent report · Speed calculated after the next report
waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.ja: 最近の報告 · 次の報告後に速度を計算
waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.zh-CN: 近期报告 · 下次报告后计算速率
waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.sw: Ripoti ya hivi karibuni · Kasi itahesabiwa baada ya ripoti inayofuata
waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.nb: Nylig rapport · Hastighet beregnes etter neste rapport
waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.ms: Laporan terkini · Kelajuan dikira selepas laporan seterusnya
waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.vi: Báo cáo gần đây · Tốc độ được tính sau báo cáo tiếp theo
waygate:traffic.awaitingRate.bn: সাম্প্রতিক প্রতিবেদন · পরবর্তী প্রতিবেদনের পর গতি গণনা করা হবে

waygate:traffic.countersHelp.ko: 누적량은 게이트웨이가 마지막으로 보고한 peer 카운터이며 재시작·재활성화 시 0부터 다시 셀 수 있습니다. 속도는 새 보고 사이의 차이입니다.
waygate:traffic.countersHelp.en: Totals are the peer counters last reported by the gateway and may restart from 0 after a restart or reactivation. Speed is the difference between new reports.
waygate:traffic.countersHelp.ja: 累計はゲートウェイが最後に報告したpeerカウンターで、再起動・再有効化時に0から数え直す場合があります。速度は新しい報告間の差分です。
waygate:traffic.countersHelp.zh-CN: 累计量是网关上次报告的 peer 计数器，重启或重新启用时可能从 0 开始重新计数。速率是新报告之间的差值。
waygate:traffic.countersHelp.sw: Jumla ni thamani za vihesabu vya kifaa rika zilizoripotiwa mara ya mwisho na lango, na zinaweza kuanza tena kutoka 0 baada ya kuanzisha upya au kuwezesha tena. Kasi ni tofauti kati ya ripoti mpya.
waygate:traffic.countersHelp.nb: Totalene er tellere for motparten som sist ble rapportert av nettverksporten, og kan starte på nytt fra 0 etter omstart eller reaktivering. Hastigheten er differansen mellom nye rapporter.
waygate:traffic.countersHelp.ms: Jumlah ialah pembilang rakan yang kali terakhir dilaporkan oleh get laluan dan mungkin bermula semula dari 0 selepas mula semula atau pengaktifan semula. Kelajuan ialah perbezaan antara laporan baharu.
waygate:traffic.countersHelp.vi: Tổng cộng là các bộ đếm của bên ngang hàng được cổng mạng báo cáo gần nhất và có thể bắt đầu lại từ 0 sau khi khởi động lại hoặc kích hoạt lại. Tốc độ là mức chênh lệch giữa các báo cáo mới.
waygate:traffic.countersHelp.bn: মোট পরিমাণ হলো গেটওয়ের সর্বশেষ প্রতিবেদনে দেওয়া পিয়ার কাউন্টার; পুনরায় চালু বা সক্রিয় করলে এগুলো আবার ০ থেকে গণনা শুরু করতে পারে। নতুন প্রতিবেদনগুলোর মধ্যকার পার্থক্য থেকে গতি নির্ণয় করা হয়।

waygate:traffic.delayed.ko: 보고 지연 · 현재 속도 알 수 없음
waygate:traffic.delayed.ja: 報告遅延 · 現在の速度は不明
waygate:traffic.delayed.zh-CN: 报告延迟 · 当前速率未知
waygate:traffic.delayed.sw: Ripoti imechelewa · Kasi ya sasa haijulikani
waygate:traffic.delayed.ms: Laporan tertunda · Kelajuan semasa tidak diketahui
waygate:traffic.delayed.vi: Báo cáo bị chậm · Không xác định được tốc độ hiện tại

waygate:traffic.disabled.ja: 無効 · トラフィック記録停止
waygate:traffic.disabled.zh-CN: 已禁用 · 流量记录已停止
waygate:traffic.disabled.vi: Đã tắt · Đã dừng ghi lưu lượng

waygate:traffic.noHandshake.ja: 最近の報告 · ハンドシェイクなし
waygate:traffic.noHandshake.sw: Ripoti ya hivi karibuni · Hakuna uthibitishano wa muunganisho
waygate:traffic.noHandshake.vi: Báo cáo gần đây · Không có bắt tay

waygate:traffic.reportSummary.ko: {ageKnown, select, yes {마지막 보고 {age}초 전} other {마지막 보고 없음}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {에이전트 보고 주기 {interval}초} other {에이전트 보고 주기 미확인}} · 최근 120초 핸드셰이크만 온라인으로 분류하며 연결을 보증하지 않습니다.
waygate:traffic.reportSummary.en: {ageKnown, select, yes {Last report {age, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} ago} other {No last report}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {Agent report interval {interval, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {Agent report interval unknown}} · Only handshakes within the last 120 seconds are classified as online; this does not guarantee connectivity.
waygate:traffic.reportSummary.ja: {ageKnown, select, yes {最終報告：{age}秒前} other {最終報告なし}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {エージェント報告間隔：{interval}秒} other {エージェント報告間隔は未確認}} · 直近120秒のハンドシェイクのみオンラインと判定し、接続を保証するものではありません。
waygate:traffic.reportSummary.zh-CN: {ageKnown, select, yes {上次报告：{age} 秒前} other {无上次报告}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {代理报告间隔：{interval} 秒} other {代理报告间隔未知}} · 仅将最近 120 秒内有握手的客户端归类为在线，不保证连接可用。
waygate:traffic.reportSummary.sw: {ageKnown, select, yes {Ripoti ya mwisho ilitolewa {age, plural, one {sekunde # iliyopita} other {sekunde # zilizopita}}} other {Hakuna ripoti ya mwisho}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {Muda kati ya ripoti za wakala ni {interval, plural, one {sekunde #} other {sekunde #}}} other {Muda kati ya ripoti za wakala haujulikani}} · Ni uthibitishano wa muunganisho uliofanyika ndani ya sekunde 120 zilizopita pekee unaoainishwa kuwa mtandaoni; hii haihakikishi uwepo wa muunganisho.
waygate:traffic.reportSummary.nb: {ageKnown, select, yes {Siste rapport for {age, plural, one {# sekund} other {# sekunder}} siden} other {Ingen siste rapport}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {Agentens rapportintervall er {interval, plural, one {# sekund} other {# sekunder}}} other {Agentens rapportintervall er ukjent}} · Bare håndtrykk i løpet av de siste 120 sekundene klassifiseres som tilkoblet. Dette garanterer ikke tilkobling.
waygate:traffic.reportSummary.ms: {ageKnown, select, yes {Laporan terakhir {age, plural, one {# saat} other {# saat}} lalu} other {Tiada laporan terakhir}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {Sela laporan ejen {interval, plural, one {# saat} other {# saat}}} other {Sela laporan ejen tidak diketahui}} · Hanya jabat tangan dalam 120 saat lalu dikelaskan sebagai dalam talian; ini tidak menjamin ketersambungan.
waygate:traffic.reportSummary.vi: {ageKnown, select, yes {Báo cáo gần nhất cách đây {age, plural, one {# giây} other {# giây}}} other {Không có báo cáo gần nhất}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {Chu kỳ báo cáo của tác nhân là {interval, plural, one {# giây} other {# giây}}} other {Không xác định được chu kỳ báo cáo của tác nhân}} · Chỉ các lần bắt tay trong 120 giây gần nhất mới được phân loại là trực tuyến; điều này không đảm bảo khả năng kết nối.
waygate:traffic.reportSummary.bn: {ageKnown, select, yes {সর্বশেষ প্রতিবেদন {age} সেকেন্ড আগে} other {আগের কোনো প্রতিবেদন নেই}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {এজেন্টের প্রতিবেদন দেওয়ার ব্যবধান {interval} সেকেন্ড} other {এজেন্টের প্রতিবেদন দেওয়ার ব্যবধান অজানা}} · শুধু গত ১২০ সেকেন্ডের মধ্যে হওয়া হ্যান্ডশেককে অনলাইন হিসেবে গণ্য করা হয়; এটি সংযোগের নিশ্চয়তা দেয় না।

waygate:validation.allowedIps.defaultRou.en: “{value}” is a default route (/0) and cannot be used.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.defaultRou.ja: 「{value}」はデフォルトルート（/0）のため使用できません。
waygate:validation.allowedIps.defaultRou.sw: “{value}” ni njia chaguo-msingi (/0) na haiwezi kutumika.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.defaultRou.nb: «{value}» er en standardrute (/0) og kan ikke brukes.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.defaultRou.ms: “{value}” ialah laluan lalai (/0) dan tidak boleh digunakan.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.defaultRou.vi: “{value}” là tuyến mặc định (/0) nên không thể dùng.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.defaultRou.bn: “{value}” একটি ডিফল্ট রুট (/0), তাই ব্যবহার করা যাবে না।

waygate:validation.allowedIps.invalid.en: “{value}” is not a valid IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.invalid.ja: 「{value}」は有効な IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ではありません。
waygate:validation.allowedIps.invalid.zh-CN: “{value}”不是有效的 IPv4 或 IPv6 CIDR。
waygate:validation.allowedIps.invalid.sw: “{value}” si CIDR halali ya IPv4 au IPv6.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.invalid.nb: «{value}» er ikke en gyldig IPv4- eller IPv6-CIDR.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.invalid.ms: “{value}” bukan CIDR IPv4 atau IPv6 yang sah.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.invalid.vi: “{value}” không phải là CIDR IPv4 hoặc IPv6 hợp lệ.
waygate:validation.allowedIps.invalid.bn: “{value}” কোনো বৈধ IPv4 বা IPv6 CIDR নয়।

waygate:validation.allowedIps.tooMany.ja: CIDR は最大 {max} 個まで入力できます。

waygate:validation.allowedIps.tunnelOver.ja: 「{value}」はトンネルサブネット {tunnel} と重複しています。
waygate:validation.allowedIps.tunnelOver.vi: “{value}” chồng lấn với mạng con đường hầm {tunnel}.

waygate:validation.dns.ko: 쉼표로 구분한 DNS 주소나 호스트 이름을 최대 두 개 입력하세요.
waygate:validation.dns.en: Enter up to two DNS addresses or hostnames, separated by commas.
waygate:validation.dns.ja: カンマ区切りのDNSアドレスまたはホスト名を最大2個入力してください。
waygate:validation.dns.zh-CN: 请输入最多两个 DNS 地址或主机名，以逗号分隔。
waygate:validation.dns.sw: Weka hadi anwani mbili za DNS au majina mawili ya host, zikitenganishwa kwa koma.
waygate:validation.dns.nb: Angi opptil to DNS-adresser eller vertsnavn, atskilt med komma.
waygate:validation.dns.ms: Masukkan sehingga dua alamat DNS atau nama hos, dipisahkan dengan koma.
waygate:validation.dns.vi: Nhập tối đa hai địa chỉ DNS hoặc tên máy chủ, phân tách bằng dấu phẩy.
waygate:validation.dns.bn: কমা দিয়ে আলাদা করে সর্বোচ্চ দুটি DNS ঠিকানা বা হোস্টনাম লিখুন।

waygate:validation.expectedClients.ja: 1〜{max} の整数を入力してください。
waygate:validation.expectedClients.zh-CN: 请输入 1 到 {max} 之间的整数。

waygate:validation.keepalive.en: Enter an integer between 0 and {max} seconds. 0 disables it.
waygate:validation.keepalive.ja: 0–{max}秒の整数を入力してください。0は無効です。
waygate:validation.keepalive.zh-CN: 请输入 0–{max} 秒之间的整数。0 表示禁用。
waygate:validation.keepalive.sw: Weka nambari kamili ya sekunde kati ya 0 na {max}. 0 huizima.
waygate:validation.keepalive.nb: Angi et heltall mellom 0 og {max} sekunder. 0 deaktiverer funksjonen.
waygate:validation.keepalive.ms: Masukkan integer antara 0 dan {max} saat. 0 melumpuhkannya.
waygate:validation.keepalive.vi: Nhập một số nguyên từ 0 đến {max} giây. Giá trị 0 sẽ tắt tính năng này.
waygate:validation.keepalive.bn: ০ থেকে {max} সেকেন্ডের মধ্যে একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা লিখুন। ০ দিলে এটি নিষ্ক্রিয় হবে।

waygate:validation.mtu.en: Enter an integer between {min} and {max}, or leave blank.
waygate:validation.mtu.ja: {min}–{max}の整数を入力するか、空欄にしてください。
waygate:validation.mtu.zh-CN: 请输入 {min}–{max} 之间的整数，或留空。
waygate:validation.mtu.sw: Weka nambari kamili kati ya {min} na {max}, au acha wazi.
waygate:validation.mtu.nb: Angi et heltall mellom {min} og {max}, eller la feltet stå tomt.
waygate:validation.mtu.ms: Masukkan integer antara {min} dan {max}, atau biarkan kosong.
waygate:validation.mtu.vi: Nhập một số nguyên từ {min} đến {max}, hoặc để trống.
waygate:validation.mtu.bn: {min} থেকে {max}-এর মধ্যে একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা লিখুন অথবা খালি রাখুন।

waygate:validation.name.ko: 영문/숫자로 시작하고 영문·숫자·하이픈·밑줄만 사용해 최대 63자로 입력하세요.
waygate:validation.name.en: Enter up to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number and using only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
waygate:validation.name.ja: 英字・数字で始まり、英字・数字・ハイフン・アンダースコアのみを使用して、最大63文字で入力してください。
waygate:validation.name.zh-CN: 请输入最多 63 个字符，以英文字母或数字开头，且仅使用英文字母、数字、连字符和下划线。
waygate:validation.name.sw: Weka hadi vibambo 63, ukianza kwa herufi au nambari na kutumia herufi, nambari, vistari vifupi na vistari vya chini pekee.
waygate:validation.name.nb: Angi opptil 63 tegn. Start med en latinsk bokstav eller et tall, og bruk bare latinske bokstaver, tall, bindestreker og understreker.
waygate:validation.name.ms: Masukkan sehingga 63 aksara, bermula dengan huruf atau nombor dan hanya menggunakan huruf, nombor, tanda sempang dan garis bawah.
waygate:validation.name.vi: Nhập tối đa 63 ký tự, bắt đầu bằng chữ cái Latin hoặc chữ số và chỉ sử dụng chữ cái Latin, chữ số, dấu gạch nối và dấu gạch dưới.
waygate:validation.name.bn: ইংরেজি অক্ষর বা সংখ্যা দিয়ে শুরু করে সর্বোচ্চ ৬৩ অক্ষর লিখুন; শুধু ইংরেজি অক্ষর, সংখ্যা, হাইফেন ও আন্ডারস্কোর ব্যবহার করুন।

waygate:workspace.selectProject.en: Select a project to manage Waygate.
waygate:workspace.selectProject.ja: Waygateを管理するプロジェクトを選択してください。
waygate:workspace.selectProject.zh-CN: 选择要管理 Waygate 的项目。
waygate:workspace.selectProject.nb: Velg et prosjekt for å administrere Waygate.
waygate:workspace.selectProject.vi: Chọn một dự án để quản lý Waygate.
waygate:workspace.selectProject.bn: Waygate পরিচালনা করতে একটি প্রকল্প নির্বাচন করুন।

workspace-iam:adminHelp.ko: 시스템 관리자는 도메인 배분 상한만 편집합니다. 프로젝트 배분과 새 프로젝트 기본값은 도메인 관리자 워크스페이스에서 관리합니다. 기존 도메인 모니터링은 읽기 전용으로 유지됩니다.
workspace-iam:adminHelp.en: System administration edits domain allocation ceilings only. Project allocations and future-project defaults belong in the domain manager workspace. Existing domain monitoring remains read-only.
workspace-iam:adminHelp.ja: システム管理者が編集するのはドメイン割り当て上限のみです。プロジェクト割り当てと新規プロジェクト既定値はドメイン管理者ワークスペースで管理します。既存のドメイン監視は読み取り専用のままです。
workspace-iam:adminHelp.zh-CN: 系统管理仅编辑域分配上限。项目分配和新项目默认值由域管理员工作区管理。现有域监控保持只读。
workspace-iam:adminHelp.sw: Usimamizi wa mfumo huhariri vikomo vya juu vya mgao wa kikoa pekee. Mgao wa miradi na chaguomsingi za miradi ya baadaye husimamiwa katika eneo la kazi la msimamizi wa kikoa. Ufuatiliaji uliopo wa kikoa unabaki wa kusoma tu.
workspace-iam:adminHelp.nb: Systemadministrasjonen redigerer bare domenets øvre tildelingsgrenser. Prosjekttildelinger og standardverdier for fremtidige prosjekter hører hjemme i domeneadministratorens arbeidsområde. Eksisterende domeneovervåking forblir skrivebeskyttet.
workspace-iam:adminHelp.ms: Pentadbiran sistem hanya menyunting had maksimum peruntukan domain. Peruntukan projek dan nilai lalai projek masa hadapan diurus dalam ruang kerja pengurus domain. Pemantauan domain sedia ada kekal baca sahaja.
workspace-iam:adminHelp.vi: Quản trị hệ thống chỉ chỉnh sửa mức trần phân bổ của miền. Việc phân bổ cho dự án và giá trị mặc định cho dự án tương lai thuộc không gian làm việc của người quản lý miền. Hoạt động giám sát miền hiện có vẫn ở chế độ chỉ đọc.
workspace-iam:adminHelp.bn: সিস্টেম প্রশাসন থেকে শুধু ডোমেন বরাদ্দের সর্বোচ্চ সীমা সম্পাদনা করা যায়। প্রকল্পের বরাদ্দ ও ভবিষ্যৎ প্রকল্পের ডিফল্ট মান ডোমেন পরিচালকের ওয়ার্কস্পেসে পরিচালিত হয়। বিদ্যমান ডোমেন পর্যবেক্ষণ শুধু পড়ার জন্যই থাকে।

workspace-iam:allocated.ja: プロジェクト上限の合計
workspace-iam:allocated.vi: Hạn mức dự án đã phân bổ

workspace-iam:allocationHelp.ko: 이 예산은 Afterglow를 통해 배분하는 프로젝트 할당량 합계를 제한합니다. 실시간 사용량이나 모든 네이티브 작업을 막는 도메인 한도가 아닙니다. 비활성 프로젝트도 포함합니다. 미설정 상한은 제한이 없고 미설정 기본값은 네이티브 정책을 따릅니다.
workspace-iam:allocationHelp.en: The budget constrains the sum of project quota allocations made through Afterglow. It is not live consumption or a universal native domain cap. Disabled projects are included. Missing ceilings are unconstrained; missing defaults use native policy.
workspace-iam:allocationHelp.ja: この予算はAfterglowを通じて割り当てるプロジェクトクォータの合計を制約します。実使用量やすべてのネイティブ操作に適用されるドメイン上限ではありません。無効なプロジェクトも含みます。未設定の上限は制約なし、未設定の既定値はネイティブポリシーに従います。
workspace-iam:allocationHelp.zh-CN: 预算约束通过Afterglow分配的项目配额总和，不代表实时使用量或适用于所有原生操作的域限额。包括已禁用的项目。未配置的上限不受限制，未配置的默认值遵循原生策略。
workspace-iam:allocationHelp.sw: Bajeti huweka kikomo kwa jumla ya viwango vya mgao vilivyogawiwa miradi kupitia Afterglow. Si matumizi ya moja kwa moja wala kikomo asilia cha jumla cha kikoa. Miradi iliyozimwa inajumuishwa. Vikomo vya juu visivyowekwa havina kizuizi; chaguomsingi zisizowekwa hutumia sera asilia.
workspace-iam:allocationHelp.nb: Budsjettet begrenser summen av prosjektkvoter som tildeles gjennom Afterglow. Det er ikke løpende forbruk eller en universell domenegrense i de underliggende tjenestene. Deaktiverte prosjekter er inkludert. Manglende øvre grenser innebærer ingen begrensning. Manglende standardverdier bruker den underliggende tjenestens policy.
workspace-iam:allocationHelp.ms: Belanjawan ini mengehadkan jumlah peruntukan kuota projek yang dibuat melalui Afterglow. Ia bukan penggunaan masa nyata atau had domain yang menyekat semua operasi asli. Projek yang dinyahaktifkan turut disertakan. Had maksimum yang tidak ditetapkan tidak dibatasi; nilai lalai yang tidak ditetapkan mengikut dasar asli.
workspace-iam:allocationHelp.vi: Ngân sách giới hạn tổng hạn ngạch được phân bổ cho các dự án qua Afterglow. Đây không phải mức sử dụng thực tế hay mức trần miền chung của dịch vụ gốc. Các dự án đã vô hiệu hóa vẫn được tính. Không đặt mức trần nghĩa là không giới hạn; không đặt giá trị mặc định thì dùng chính sách của dịch vụ gốc.
workspace-iam:allocationHelp.bn: এই বাজেট Afterglow-এর মাধ্যমে করা প্রকল্পের কোটা বরাদ্দের সমষ্টিকে সীমাবদ্ধ করে। এটি তাৎক্ষণিক ব্যবহার বা সব নেটিভ কাজের ওপর প্রযোজ্য সার্বজনীন ডোমেন সীমা নয়। নিষ্ক্রিয় প্রকল্পও অন্তর্ভুক্ত থাকে। সর্বোচ্চ সীমা নির্ধারিত না থাকলে কোনো বাধা থাকে না; ডিফল্ট মান নির্ধারিত না থাকলে নেটিভ নীতি ব্যবহৃত হয়।

workspace-iam:attributionHelp.ko: 비활성 프로젝트와 참여 사용자를 포함하여 정확히 일치하는 도메인의 프로젝트 리소스를 관측합니다. 프로젝트 한도는 사용량이 아닌 배분입니다. 일부 값은 하한값이며 관측 불가와 미지원은 0이 아닙니다.
workspace-iam:attributionHelp.en: Resources are observed across exact-domain projects, including disabled projects and joined users. Project limits are allocations, not consumption. Partial values are lower bounds; unavailable and unsupported observations are never zero.
workspace-iam:attributionHelp.ja: 無効なプロジェクトと参加ユーザーを含め、ドメインが完全一致するプロジェクトのリソースを観測します。プロジェクト上限は使用量ではなく割り当てです。一部の値は下限値であり、観測不可や未対応はゼロではありません。
workspace-iam:attributionHelp.zh-CN: 观测域完全匹配的项目资源，包括已禁用的项目和加入的用户。项目限额是分配量而非使用量。部分值为下界值；不可观测和不支持绝不代表零。
workspace-iam:attributionHelp.sw: Rasilimali huangaliwa katika miradi ya kikoa hicho hicho pekee, ikijumuisha miradi iliyozimwa na watumiaji waliojiunga. Vikomo vya miradi ni mgao, si matumizi. Thamani zisizokamilika ni mipaka ya chini; taarifa zisizopatikana na zisizotumika hazimaanishi sifuri kamwe.
workspace-iam:attributionHelp.nb: Ressurser observeres på tvers av prosjekter i nøyaktig dette domenet, inkludert deaktiverte prosjekter og tilknyttede brukere. Prosjektgrenser er tildelinger, ikke forbruk. Delvise verdier er nedre grenser. Utilgjengelige og ikke-støttede observasjoner er aldri null.
workspace-iam:attributionHelp.ms: Sumber diperhatikan merentas projek dalam domain yang sepadan tepat, termasuk projek yang dinyahaktifkan dan pengguna yang menyertainya. Had projek ialah peruntukan, bukan penggunaan. Nilai separa ialah batas bawah; pemerhatian yang tidak tersedia atau tidak disokong tidak sekali-kali bermaksud sifar.
workspace-iam:attributionHelp.vi: Tài nguyên được quan sát trên các dự án thuộc đúng miền, bao gồm các dự án đã vô hiệu hóa và người dùng đã tham gia. Hạn mức dự án là mức phân bổ, không phải mức sử dụng. Giá trị chưa đầy đủ là giới hạn dưới; quan sát không khả dụng hoặc không được hỗ trợ không bao giờ được xem là bằng không.
workspace-iam:attributionHelp.bn: হুবহু একই ডোমেনের প্রকল্পগুলো জুড়ে রিসোর্স পর্যবেক্ষণ করা হয়; নিষ্ক্রিয় প্রকল্প ও যোগ দেওয়া ব্যবহারকারীরাও অন্তর্ভুক্ত থাকে। প্রকল্পের সীমা হলো বরাদ্দ, ব্যবহার নয়। আংশিক মানগুলো নিম্নসীমা; অনুপলব্ধ ও অসমর্থিত পর্যবেক্ষণ কখনো শূন্য নয়।

workspace-iam:attributionScope.sw: Wigo wa kuhusisha rasilimali na wamiliki

workspace-iam:budgetSaved.ko: 할당 예산을 저장했습니다. 다시 편집하기 전에 현재 정책을 불러오세요.
workspace-iam:budgetSaved.en: The allocation budget was saved. Reload the current policy before another edit.
workspace-iam:budgetSaved.ja: 割り当て予算を保存しました。次の編集前に現在のポリシーを再読み込みしてください。
workspace-iam:budgetSaved.zh-CN: 分配预算已保存。再次编辑前，请重新加载当前策略。
workspace-iam:budgetSaved.sw: Bajeti ya mgao imehifadhiwa. Pakia upya sera ya sasa kabla ya kuhariri tena.
workspace-iam:budgetSaved.nb: Tildelingsbudsjettet ble lagret. Last inn gjeldende policy på nytt før du redigerer igjen.
workspace-iam:budgetSaved.ms: Belanjawan peruntukan telah disimpan. Muat semula dasar semasa sebelum menyunting lagi.
workspace-iam:budgetSaved.vi: Đã lưu ngân sách phân bổ. Hãy tải lại chính sách hiện tại trước khi chỉnh sửa tiếp.
workspace-iam:budgetSaved.bn: বরাদ্দ বাজেট সংরক্ষণ করা হয়েছে। আবার সম্পাদনার আগে বর্তমান নীতি লোড করুন।

workspace-iam:chooseScope.ko: 귀속 리소스를 볼 프로젝트 또는 사용자를 선택하세요.
workspace-iam:chooseScope.en: Choose a project or user to view attributed resources.
workspace-iam:chooseScope.ja: 帰属リソースを表示するプロジェクトまたはユーザーを選択してください。
workspace-iam:chooseScope.zh-CN: 请选择项目或用户以查看归属资源。
workspace-iam:chooseScope.sw: Chagua mradi au mtumiaji ili kuona rasilimali zinazohusishwa naye.
workspace-iam:chooseScope.nb: Velg et prosjekt eller en bruker for å vise tilknyttede ressurser.
workspace-iam:chooseScope.ms: Pilih projek atau pengguna untuk melihat sumber yang dikaitkan dengannya.
workspace-iam:chooseScope.vi: Chọn dự án hoặc người dùng để xem tài nguyên được quy thuộc.
workspace-iam:chooseScope.bn: মালিকানাভিত্তিক রিসোর্স দেখতে একটি প্রকল্প বা ব্যবহারকারী বেছে নিন।

workspace-iam:coverageNotes.vi: Chẩn đoán phạm vi bao phủ

workspace-iam:default.ja: 新規プロジェクト既定値
workspace-iam:default.vi: Mặc định cho dự án mới

workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.ko: 기본값은 이후 Afterglow에서 생성하는 프로젝트에만 적용됩니다. 기존 프로젝트 한도는 변경하지 않습니다.
workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.en: Defaults apply only to future projects created through Afterglow. They never rewrite existing project limits.
workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.ja: 既定値は今後Afterglowで作成するプロジェクトだけに適用されます。既存のプロジェクト上限は変更しません。
workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.zh-CN: 默认值仅适用于今后通过Afterglow创建的项目，绝不修改现有项目的限额。
workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.sw: Chaguomsingi hutumika kwa miradi ya baadaye inayoundwa kupitia Afterglow pekee. Hazibadilishi kamwe vikomo vya miradi iliyopo.
workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.nb: Standardverdiene gjelder bare fremtidige prosjekter som opprettes gjennom Afterglow. De overskriver aldri eksisterende prosjektgrenser.
workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.ms: Nilai lalai hanya digunakan untuk projek yang dicipta melalui Afterglow pada masa hadapan. Nilai ini tidak sekali-kali mengubah had projek sedia ada.
workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.vi: Giá trị mặc định chỉ áp dụng cho các dự án được tạo qua Afterglow trong tương lai. Các giá trị này không bao giờ ghi đè hạn mức của dự án hiện có.
workspace-iam:defaultsHelp.bn: ডিফল্ট মান শুধু ভবিষ্যতে Afterglow-এর মাধ্যমে তৈরি প্রকল্পে প্রযোজ্য। এগুলো কখনো বিদ্যমান প্রকল্পের সীমা বদলায় না।

workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.ko: 기본값을 저장했습니다. 현재 정책을 새로 불러오세요.
workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.en: Defaults were saved. Reload to observe the current policy.
workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.ja: 既定値を保存しました。現在のポリシーを再読み込みしてください。
workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.zh-CN: 默认值已保存。请重新加载当前策略。
workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.sw: Chaguomsingi zimehifadhiwa. Pakia upya ili kuona sera ya sasa.
workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.nb: Standardverdiene ble lagret. Last inn på nytt for å se gjeldende policy.
workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.ms: Nilai lalai telah disimpan. Muat semula untuk memerhatikan dasar semasa.
workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.vi: Đã lưu giá trị mặc định. Hãy tải lại để xem chính sách hiện tại.
workspace-iam:defaultsSaved.bn: ডিফল্ট মান সংরক্ষণ করা হয়েছে। বর্তমান নীতি দেখতে আবার লোড করুন।

workspace-iam:denied.ja: システム管理者権限が必要です。
workspace-iam:denied.sw: Mamlaka ya msimamizi wa mfumo inahitajika.
workspace-iam:denied.vi: Yêu cầu quyền quản trị viên hệ thống.

workspace-iam:disabledService.ko: 비활성화된 서비스이므로 할당량을 편집할 수 없습니다.
workspace-iam:disabledService.en: This service is disabled; its quotas cannot be edited.
workspace-iam:disabledService.ja: このサービスは無効なため、クォータを編集できません。
workspace-iam:disabledService.zh-CN: 此服务已禁用，无法编辑其配额。
workspace-iam:disabledService.sw: Huduma hii imezimwa; viwango vyake vya mgao haviwezi kuhaririwa.
workspace-iam:disabledService.nb: Denne tjenesten er deaktivert. Kvotene kan ikke redigeres.
workspace-iam:disabledService.ms: Perkhidmatan ini dinyahaktifkan; kuotanya tidak boleh disunting.
workspace-iam:disabledService.vi: Dịch vụ này đã bị vô hiệu hóa; không thể chỉnh sửa hạn ngạch của dịch vụ.
workspace-iam:disabledService.bn: এই পরিষেবা নিষ্ক্রিয়; এর কোটা সম্পাদনা করা যাবে না।

workspace-iam:domainBudget.ja: ドメイン割り当て予算
workspace-iam:domainBudget.vi: Ngân sách phân bổ của miền

workspace-iam:drift.ko: 관측된 배분이 도메인 상한을 초과했습니다. 외부 네이티브 변경으로 차이가 생길 수 있으며 배분 감소나 복구도 서버 검증을 거칩니다.
workspace-iam:drift.en: Observed allocations exceed a domain ceiling. External native changes can cause drift; lowering or repairing allocations remains subject to server validation.
workspace-iam:drift.ja: 観測された割り当てがドメイン上限を超えています。外部のネイティブ変更により差異が生じます。割り当ての削減や修復にもサーバー検証が必要です。
workspace-iam:drift.zh-CN: 观测到的分配超出域上限。外部原生修改可能导致偏差；减少或修复分配仍须通过服务器验证。
workspace-iam:drift.sw: Mgao ulioonekana unazidi kikomo cha juu cha kikoa. Mabadiliko ya nje katika huduma asilia yanaweza kusababisha tofauti; kupunguza au kurekebisha mgao bado kunategemea uthibitishaji wa seva.
workspace-iam:drift.nb: Observerte tildelinger overstiger en øvre domenegrense. Eksterne endringer i de underliggende tjenestene kan føre til avvik. Reduksjon eller korrigering av tildelinger må fortsatt valideres av serveren.
workspace-iam:drift.ms: Peruntukan yang diperhatikan melebihi had maksimum domain. Perubahan asli di luar Afterglow boleh menyebabkan penyimpangan; pengurangan atau pembetulan peruntukan masih tertakluk pada pengesahan pelayan.
workspace-iam:drift.vi: Mức phân bổ quan sát được vượt quá mức trần của miền. Các thay đổi bên ngoài trên dịch vụ gốc có thể gây sai lệch; việc giảm hoặc sửa mức phân bổ vẫn phải qua kiểm tra của máy chủ.
workspace-iam:drift.bn: পর্যবেক্ষিত বরাদ্দ ডোমেনের সর্বোচ্চ সীমা অতিক্রম করেছে। বাইরের নেটিভ পরিবর্তন থেকে এই অমিল হতে পারে; বরাদ্দ কমানো বা সংশোধন করাও সার্ভারের যাচাইয়ের অধীন।

workspace-iam:durableBlocker.ko: 영구 기록된 할당량 작업이 적용 중이거나 결과를 알 수 없습니다. 추가 할당량 및 정책 변경이 차단됩니다. 관측값을 새로 불러오세요. 시스템 관리자가 네이티브 호출 종료를 확인한 뒤 조정해야 합니다. 원래 변경 요청을 재실행하지 마세요.
workspace-iam:durableBlocker.en: A durable quota operation is still applying or has an unknown outcome. Further quota and policy writes are blocked. Reload observations; a system administrator must confirm native calls have settled before reconciliation. Never replay the original mutation.
workspace-iam:durableBlocker.ja: 永続記録されたクォータ操作が適用中、または結果不明です。追加のクォータおよびポリシー変更はブロックされます。観測値を再読み込みしてください。システム管理者がネイティブ呼び出しの終了を確認してから照合する必要があります。元の変更要求を再実行しないでください。
workspace-iam:durableBlocker.zh-CN: 持久记录的配额操作仍在应用或结果未知。进一步的配额与策略写入已阻止。请重新加载观测值；系统管理员必须先确认原生调用均已结束，再进行核对。切勿重放原始变更请求。
workspace-iam:durableBlocker.sw: Operesheni ya kiwango cha mgao yenye rekodi ya kudumu bado inatekelezwa au matokeo yake hayajulikani. Uandikaji zaidi wa viwango vya mgao na sera umezuiwa. Pakia upya taarifa zilizoonekana; msimamizi wa mfumo lazima athibitishe kwamba miito asilia imekamilika kabla ya upatanishaji. Usirudie kamwe ombi la awali la mabadiliko.
workspace-iam:durableBlocker.nb: En varig lagret kvoteoperasjon utføres fortsatt eller har et ukjent utfall. Flere skriveoperasjoner for kvoter og policy er blokkert. Last inn observasjonene på nytt. En systemadministrator må bekrefte at kallene til de underliggende tjenestene er avsluttet før avstemming. Gjenta aldri den opprinnelige endringen.
workspace-iam:durableBlocker.ms: Operasi kuota yang direkodkan secara kekal masih sedang diterapkan atau hasilnya tidak diketahui. Perubahan kuota dan dasar selanjutnya disekat. Muat semula pemerhatian; pentadbir sistem mesti mengesahkan bahawa panggilan asli telah selesai sebelum penyelarasan. Jangan sekali-kali melaksanakan semula permintaan perubahan asal.
workspace-iam:durableBlocker.vi: Một thao tác hạn ngạch được lưu bền vững vẫn đang được áp dụng hoặc chưa rõ kết quả. Các thao tác ghi hạn ngạch và chính sách tiếp theo bị chặn. Hãy tải lại dữ liệu quan sát; quản trị viên hệ thống phải xác nhận các lời gọi dịch vụ gốc đã kết thúc trước khi đối soát. Không bao giờ gửi lại thao tác thay đổi ban đầu.
workspace-iam:durableBlocker.bn: স্থায়ীভাবে নথিভুক্ত একটি কোটা কার্যক্রম এখনো প্রয়োগ হচ্ছে অথবা এর ফলাফল অজানা। পরবর্তী কোটা ও নীতির পরিবর্তন বন্ধ রাখা হয়েছে। পর্যবেক্ষণ আবার লোড করুন; সমন্বয়ের আগে সিস্টেম প্রশাসককে নিশ্চিত করতে হবে যে মূল নেটিভ কলগুলো শেষ হয়েছে। মূল পরিবর্তনের অনুরোধ কখনো পুনরায় চালাবেন না।

workspace-iam:invalidLimit.en: Enter whole numbers of zero or greater, or -1 for unlimited. Leave a field blank to omit it.
workspace-iam:invalidLimit.ja: 0以上の整数、または無制限を示す-1を入力してください。空欄の項目は省略されます。
workspace-iam:invalidLimit.zh-CN: 请输入大于等于零的整数，或输入-1表示无限制。留空的字段将被省略。
workspace-iam:invalidLimit.sw: Weka namba kamili za sifuri au zaidi, au -1 kwa bila kikomo. Acha sehemu wazi ili isiwe sehemu ya ombi.
workspace-iam:invalidLimit.nb: Angi heltall fra null og oppover, eller -1 for ubegrenset. La et felt stå tomt for å utelate det.
workspace-iam:invalidLimit.ms: Masukkan integer sifar atau lebih besar, atau -1 untuk tanpa had. Biarkan medan kosong untuk mengecualikannya.
workspace-iam:invalidLimit.vi: Nhập số nguyên không âm hoặc -1 để không giới hạn. Để trống một trường nếu muốn bỏ qua trường đó.
workspace-iam:invalidLimit.bn: শূন্য বা তার বেশি পূর্ণসংখ্যা লিখুন, অথবা সীমাহীন বোঝাতে -1 লিখুন। কোনো ক্ষেত্র বাদ দিতে সেটি ফাঁকা রাখুন।

workspace-iam:inventory.ja: 観測されたリソース一覧
workspace-iam:inventory.vi: Danh mục tài nguyên quan sát được

workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.ko: 표시용 메타데이터만 포함합니다. 사용자 소유권을 모르면 미귀속으로 유지하며 모든 프로젝트 구성원에게 배분하지 않습니다. 미지원 서비스는 관측 표에 명시합니다.
workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.en: Display metadata only. Unknown user ownership stays unattributed and is not assigned to every project member. Unsupported services are explicit in the observation table.
workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.ja: 表示用メタデータのみです。ユーザー所有者が不明な場合は未帰属のままとし、全プロジェクトメンバーには割り当てません。未対応のサービスは観測表に明示されます。
workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.zh-CN: 仅包含显示用元数据。用户所有权未知时保持未归属，不会分配给所有项目成员。不支持的服务在观测表中明确显示。
workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.sw: Onyesha metadata pekee. Rasilimali ambazo mmiliki wake wa mtumiaji hajulikani hubaki bila kuhusishwa na mtumiaji na hazihusishwi na kila mwanachama wa mradi. Huduma zisizotumika zinaonyeshwa wazi katika jedwali la taarifa zilizoonekana.
workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.nb: Viser bare metadata. Ukjent brukereierskap forblir uten tilknytning og tilordnes ikke alle prosjektmedlemmer. Tjenester som ikke støttes, vises uttrykkelig i observasjonstabellen.
workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.ms: Hanya metadata untuk paparan disertakan. Pemilikan pengguna yang tidak diketahui kekal tanpa atribusi dan tidak diagihkan kepada setiap ahli projek. Perkhidmatan yang tidak disokong dinyatakan secara jelas dalam jadual pemerhatian.
workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.vi: Chỉ hiển thị siêu dữ liệu. Tài nguyên chưa rõ người dùng sở hữu được giữ ở trạng thái chưa quy thuộc, không gán cho mọi thành viên dự án. Dịch vụ không được hỗ trợ được nêu rõ trong bảng quan sát.
workspace-iam:inventoryHelp.bn: শুধু প্রদর্শনের মেটাডেটা। ব্যবহারকারীর মালিকানা অজানা থাকলে তা অনির্ধারিতই থাকে; প্রকল্পের প্রতিটি সদস্যকে তা বরাদ্দ করা হয় না। অসমর্থিত পরিষেবাগুলো পর্যবেক্ষণের সারণিতে স্পষ্টভাবে উল্লেখ করা হয়।

workspace-iam:monitoringForecast.ja: ドメインクォータ予測
workspace-iam:monitoringForecast.sw: Utabiri wa kiwango cha mgao wa kikoa

workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.ko: 모든 도메인 프로젝트의 Nova 사용 이력을 검증한 경우에만 일별 할당량의 선형 추세를 계산합니다. 실제 사용률이나 수요 예측이 아닙니다. 스토리지·GPU·그 밖의 서비스는 도메인 전체 이력이 없어 예측할 수 없습니다. 미지원·거부·누락은 0이 아닙니다.
workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.en: Daily allocation trends are calculated only from verified Nova usage history for every domain project. This is not actual utilization or a demand forecast. Storage, GPU and other services have no whole-domain history here, so forecasts are unavailable. Unsupported, denied and missing data are not zero.
workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.ja: ドメイン内の全プロジェクトで検証できたNova使用履歴からのみ日別割り当ての線形傾向を計算します。実使用率や需要予測ではありません。ストレージ、GPU、その他のサービスにはドメイン全体の履歴がなく予測できません。未対応、拒否、欠損はゼロではありません。
workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.zh-CN: 仅在验证域内所有项目的Nova使用历史后计算每日分配量的线性趋势。这不是实际利用率或需求预测。存储、GPU及其他服务没有整个域的历史，因此无法预测。不支持、拒绝及缺失不代表零。
workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.sw: Mwelekeo wa mstari wa mgao wa kila siku hukokotolewa tu kutoka historia ya matumizi ya Nova iliyothibitishwa kwa kila mradi wa kikoa. Haya si matumizi halisi wala utabiri wa mahitaji. Hifadhi, GPU na huduma nyingine hazina historia ya kikoa chote hapa, hivyo utabiri haupatikani. Data isiyotumika, iliyokataliwa au inayokosekana si sifuri.
workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.nb: Lineære trender for daglig tildeling beregnes bare fra verifisert Nova-brukshistorikk for hvert prosjekt i domenet. Dette er ikke faktisk utnyttelse eller en etterspørselsprognose. Lagring, GPU og andre tjenester har ingen historikk for hele domenet her, så prognoser er utilgjengelige. Ustøttede, avviste og manglende data er ikke null.
workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.ms: Trend linear peruntukan harian hanya dikira daripada sejarah penggunaan Nova yang disahkan untuk setiap projek domain. Ini bukan penggunaan sebenar atau ramalan permintaan. Storan, GPU dan perkhidmatan lain tiada sejarah seluruh domain di sini, jadi ramalan tidak tersedia. Data tidak disokong, ditolak atau hilang bukan sifar.
workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.vi: Xu hướng tuyến tính của phân bổ hằng ngày chỉ được tính từ lịch sử sử dụng Nova đã xác minh của mọi dự án trong miền. Đây không phải mức sử dụng thực tế hay dự báo nhu cầu. Lưu trữ, GPU và các dịch vụ khác không có lịch sử toàn miền tại đây nên không thể dự báo. Dữ liệu không hỗ trợ, bị từ chối hoặc bị thiếu không phải là số không.
workspace-iam:monitoringForecastHelp.bn: ডোমেনের প্রতিটি প্রকল্পের যাচাইকৃত Nova ব্যবহারের ইতিহাস থেকেই দৈনিক বরাদ্দের রৈখিক প্রবণতা গণনা করা হয়। এটি প্রকৃত ব্যবহার বা চাহিদার পূর্বাভাস নয়। স্টোরেজ, GPU ও অন্যান্য পরিষেবার সম্পূর্ণ ডোমেনের ইতিহাস নেই, তাই পূর্বাভাস অনুপলব্ধ। অসমর্থিত, প্রত্যাখ্যাত বা অনুপস্থিত তথ্য শূন্য নয়।

workspace-iam:monitoringForecastUnavaila.zh-CN: 没有经过验证的趋势历史 — 无法预测

workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.ko: 선택한 프로젝트가 아닌 현재 도메인 전체를 관측합니다. 리소스, 예측, 배분은 독립적으로 불러오며 한 영역의 장애가 다른 관측값을 숨기지 않습니다.
workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.en: Observe the entire current domain, not the selected project. Resources, forecasts and allocations load independently; one section's failure does not hide other observations.
workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.ja: 選択中のプロジェクトではなく現在のドメイン全体を観測します。リソース、予測、割り当ては独立して読み込み、一部の障害で他の観測値を隠しません。
workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.zh-CN: 观测当前整个域，而非选中的项目。资源、预测和分配独立加载；某个区域失败不会隐藏其他观测值。
workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.sw: Angalia kikoa chote cha sasa, si mradi uliochaguliwa. Rasilimali, utabiri na mgao hupakiwa kando; hitilafu ya sehemu moja haifichi uchunguzi mwingine.
workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.nb: Observer hele gjeldende domene, ikke det valgte prosjektet. Ressurser, prognoser og tildelinger lastes uavhengig; feil i én del skjuler ikke andre observasjoner.
workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.ms: Pantau seluruh domain semasa, bukan projek yang dipilih. Sumber, ramalan dan peruntukan dimuat secara berasingan; kegagalan satu bahagian tidak menyembunyikan pemerhatian lain.
workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.vi: Quan sát toàn bộ miền hiện tại, không chỉ dự án được chọn. Tài nguyên, dự báo và phân bổ tải độc lập; lỗi ở một phần không che khuất các quan sát khác.
workspace-iam:monitoringHelp.bn: নির্বাচিত প্রকল্প নয়, বর্তমান সম্পূর্ণ ডোমেন পর্যবেক্ষণ করুন। রিসোর্স, পূর্বাভাস ও বরাদ্দ আলাদাভাবে লোড হয়; একটি অংশের ব্যর্থতা অন্য পর্যবেক্ষণ লুকায় না।

workspace-iam:noChanges.en: Change at least one project limit before saving.
workspace-iam:noChanges.ja: 保存するにはプロジェクト上限を1つ以上変更してください。
workspace-iam:noChanges.zh-CN: 请至少修改一个项目限额后再保存。
workspace-iam:noChanges.sw: Badilisha angalau kikomo kimoja cha mradi kabla ya kuhifadhi.
workspace-iam:noChanges.nb: Endre minst én prosjektgrense før du lagrer.
workspace-iam:noChanges.ms: Ubah sekurang-kurangnya satu had projek sebelum menyimpan.
workspace-iam:noChanges.vi: Thay đổi ít nhất một hạn mức dự án trước khi lưu.
workspace-iam:noChanges.bn: সংরক্ষণের আগে অন্তত একটি প্রকল্পের সীমা পরিবর্তন করুন।

workspace-iam:noMemberships.ja: 有効なプロジェクト所属は観測されませんでした。
workspace-iam:noMemberships.zh-CN: 未观测到有效项目成员身份。
workspace-iam:noMemberships.sw: Hakuna uanachama halisi wa mradi ulioonekana.
workspace-iam:noMemberships.ms: Tiada keahlian projek berkuat kuasa yang diperhatikan.
workspace-iam:noMemberships.vi: Chưa quan sát thấy tư cách thành viên dự án có hiệu lực nào.
workspace-iam:noMemberships.bn: কোনো কার্যকর প্রকল্প সদস্যপদ পর্যবেক্ষিত হয়নি।

workspace-iam:noObservations.ko: 관측된 행이 없습니다. 관측 범위 누락이 리소스가 없다는 증거는 아닙니다.
workspace-iam:noObservations.en: No observed rows. Missing coverage is not proof that no resources exist.
workspace-iam:noObservations.ja: 観測された行はありません。観測範囲の欠落はリソースが存在しない証拠ではありません。
workspace-iam:noObservations.zh-CN: 没有观测到记录。观测范围缺失不代表资源不存在。
workspace-iam:noObservations.sw: Hakuna safu mlalo zilizoonekana. Kukosekana kwa ufunikaji si uthibitisho kwamba hakuna rasilimali.
workspace-iam:noObservations.nb: Ingen observerte rader. Manglende dekning beviser ikke at det ikke finnes ressurser.
workspace-iam:noObservations.ms: Tiada baris yang diperhatikan. Ketiadaan liputan tidak membuktikan bahawa tiada sumber wujud.
workspace-iam:noObservations.vi: Không có dòng dữ liệu quan sát. Thiếu dữ liệu bao phủ không chứng minh rằng không có tài nguyên.
workspace-iam:noObservations.bn: কোনো পর্যবেক্ষিত সারি নেই। পর্যবেক্ষণের আওতায় না থাকা মানেই রিসোর্স নেই, তার প্রমাণ নয়।

workspace-iam:noOperations.ja: クォータ操作の記録はありません。
workspace-iam:noOperations.sw: Hakuna operesheni za viwango vya mgao zilizorekodiwa.
workspace-iam:noOperations.vi: Chưa ghi nhận thao tác hạn ngạch nào.

workspace-iam:operation.applying.ja: 適用中 — 変更をブロック
workspace-iam:operation.applying.zh-CN: 正在应用 — 写入已阻止

workspace-iam:operation.observed.ja: 現在のネイティブ観測値
workspace-iam:operation.observed.sw: Taarifa ya sasa iliyoonekana katika huduma asilia
workspace-iam:operation.observed.vi: Quan sát hiện tại từ dịch vụ gốc

workspace-iam:operation.reconciled.vi: Dữ liệu quan sát đã đối soát

workspace-iam:operation.unknown.ko: 결과 알 수 없음 — 변경 차단
workspace-iam:operation.unknown.ja: 結果不明 — 変更をブロック
workspace-iam:operation.unknown.zh-CN: 结果未知 — 写入已阻止
workspace-iam:operation.unknown.vi: Chưa rõ kết quả — chặn ghi

workspace-iam:operation.updated.ja: 再読み取りで検証済み
workspace-iam:operation.updated.vi: Đã xác minh bằng cách đọc lại

workspace-iam:operation.verified.ja: 再読み取りで検証済み
workspace-iam:operation.verified.vi: Đã xác minh bằng cách đọc lại

workspace-iam:operation.writing.vi: Đang ghi vào dịch vụ gốc

workspace-iam:operations.ja: 最近の永続クォータ操作記録
workspace-iam:operations.zh-CN: 最近的持久配额操作记录
workspace-iam:operations.sw: Operesheni za hivi karibuni za viwango vya mgao zenye rekodi za kudumu
workspace-iam:operations.ms: Operasi kuota terkini yang direkodkan secara kekal
workspace-iam:operations.vi: Các thao tác hạn ngạch được lưu bền vững gần đây

workspace-iam:partialOutcome.ko: 작업이 일부만 적용되었습니다. 새로 불러온 후 영구 기록된 서비스별 결과를 확인하세요. 요청을 재실행하지 마세요.
workspace-iam:partialOutcome.en: The operation was only partially applied. Inspect its durable service results after reloading; do not replay the request.
workspace-iam:partialOutcome.ja: 操作は一部だけ適用されました。再読み込みして永続記録されたサービス別の結果を確認してください。要求を再実行しないでください。
workspace-iam:partialOutcome.zh-CN: 操作仅部分应用。请重新加载并检查持久记录中的各服务结果，不要重放请求。
workspace-iam:partialOutcome.sw: Operesheni imetekelezwa kwa sehemu tu. Kagua matokeo yake ya huduma yaliyorekodiwa kwa kudumu baada ya kupakia upya; usirudie ombi.
workspace-iam:partialOutcome.nb: Operasjonen ble bare delvis utført. Last inn på nytt og undersøk de varig lagrede resultatene per tjeneste. Ikke gjenta forespørselen.
workspace-iam:partialOutcome.ms: Operasi hanya diterapkan sebahagiannya. Selepas memuat semula, periksa hasil setiap perkhidmatan yang direkodkan secara kekal; jangan laksanakan semula permintaan itu.
workspace-iam:partialOutcome.vi: Thao tác chỉ được áp dụng một phần. Sau khi tải lại, hãy kiểm tra kết quả dịch vụ đã lưu bền vững; không gửi lại yêu cầu.
workspace-iam:partialOutcome.bn: কার্যক্রমটি শুধু আংশিক প্রয়োগ হয়েছে। আবার লোড করে স্থায়ীভাবে নথিভুক্ত পরিষেবাভিত্তিক ফলাফল দেখুন; অনুরোধটি পুনরায় চালাবেন না।

workspace-iam:policyHelp.ko: -1은 무제한입니다. 빈 필드는 해당 정책 항목을 제거합니다. 상한은 제한이 없어지고 기본값은 네이티브 정책을 따릅니다. RAM은 MiB, 저장 공간은 GiB이며 나머지 단위는 리소스 이름에 표시됩니다.
workspace-iam:policyHelp.en: Use -1 for unlimited. A blank field removes that policy entry: ceilings become unconstrained; defaults defer to the native service. RAM is MiB, storage is GiB; other units are shown in resource labels.
workspace-iam:policyHelp.ja: -1は無制限です。空欄にするとそのポリシー項目が削除され、上限は制約なし、既定値はネイティブポリシーになります。RAMはMiB、ストレージはGiBです。他の単位はリソース名に表示されます。
workspace-iam:policyHelp.zh-CN: -1表示无限制。留空将删除该策略项：上限变为不受限制，默认值遵循原生策略。RAM单位为MiB，存储单位为GiB；其他单位显示在资源名称中。
workspace-iam:policyHelp.sw: Tumia -1 kwa bila kikomo. Sehemu tupu huondoa kipengee hicho cha sera: vikomo vya juu huachwa bila kizuizi; chaguomsingi huachiwa huduma asilia. RAM hupimwa kwa MiB, hifadhi kwa GiB; vipimo vingine vinaonyeshwa kwenye lebo za rasilimali.
workspace-iam:policyHelp.nb: Bruk -1 for ubegrenset. Et tomt felt fjerner den aktuelle policyoppføringen: øvre grenser blir ubegrensede, og standardverdier overlates til den underliggende tjenesten. RAM angis i MiB og lagring i GiB. Andre enheter vises i ressursetikettene.
workspace-iam:policyHelp.ms: Gunakan -1 untuk tanpa had. Medan kosong membuang entri dasar tersebut: had maksimum tidak lagi dibatasi; nilai lalai mengikut perkhidmatan asli. RAM dalam MiB, storan dalam GiB; unit lain ditunjukkan pada label sumber.
workspace-iam:policyHelp.vi: Dùng -1 để không giới hạn. Để trống sẽ xóa mục đó khỏi chính sách: mức trần trở thành không giới hạn; giá trị mặc định sẽ theo dịch vụ gốc. RAM tính bằng MiB, lưu trữ tính bằng GiB; các đơn vị khác được ghi trong nhãn tài nguyên.
workspace-iam:policyHelp.bn: সীমাহীন বোঝাতে -1 ব্যবহার করুন। ফাঁকা ক্ষেত্র সংশ্লিষ্ট নীতির এন্ট্রি সরিয়ে দেয়: সর্বোচ্চ সীমা আর আরোপিত থাকে না এবং ডিফল্ট মান নেটিভ পরিষেবার নীতি অনুসরণ করে। RAM-এর একক MiB, স্টোরেজের একক GiB; অন্য এককগুলো রিসোর্সের নামে দেখানো হয়।

workspace-iam:projectHelp.ko: 변경된 필드만 전송합니다. 빈 필드는 네이티브 한도를 유지합니다. -1은 알 수 없음이 아닌 무제한입니다. 사용량과 예약량은 별도 관측값이며 배분 한도에 더하지 않습니다.
workspace-iam:projectHelp.en: Only changed fields are sent. A blank field leaves the native limit unchanged. -1 means unlimited, not unknown. In-use and reserved observations are separate and are never added to allocation limits.
workspace-iam:projectHelp.ja: 変更した項目だけを送信します。空欄はネイティブ上限を維持します。-1は不明ではなく無制限です。使用量と予約量は別の観測値であり、割り当て上限に加算しません。
workspace-iam:projectHelp.zh-CN: 只发送修改的字段。留空将保留原生限额。-1表示无限制，而不是未知。使用量和预留量分别观测，绝不加入分配限额。
workspace-iam:projectHelp.sw: Sehemu zilizobadilishwa pekee hutumwa. Sehemu tupu huacha kikomo asilia bila kubadilishwa. -1 humaanisha bila kikomo, si kwamba haijulikani. Taarifa za matumizi na zilizotengwa huonyeshwa kando na haziongezwi kamwe kwenye vikomo vya mgao.
workspace-iam:projectHelp.nb: Bare endrede felt sendes. Et tomt felt lar grensen i den underliggende tjenesten være uendret. -1 betyr ubegrenset, ikke ukjent. Observasjoner av bruk og reservasjoner er separate og legges aldri til tildelingsgrensene.
workspace-iam:projectHelp.ms: Hanya medan yang diubah dihantar. Medan kosong mengekalkan had asli tanpa perubahan. -1 bermaksud tanpa had, bukan tidak diketahui. Pemerhatian penggunaan dan tempahan adalah berasingan dan tidak pernah ditambahkan pada had peruntukan.
workspace-iam:projectHelp.vi: Chỉ gửi các trường đã thay đổi. Trường trống giữ nguyên hạn mức của dịch vụ gốc. -1 nghĩa là không giới hạn, không phải chưa rõ. Dữ liệu quan sát đang sử dụng và đã giữ chỗ được tách riêng, không bao giờ cộng vào hạn mức phân bổ.
workspace-iam:projectHelp.bn: শুধু পরিবর্তিত ক্ষেত্রগুলো পাঠানো হয়। ফাঁকা ক্ষেত্র নেটিভ সীমা অপরিবর্তিত রাখে। -1 মানে সীমাহীন, অজানা নয়। ব্যবহৃত ও সংরক্ষিত পরিমাণ আলাদা পর্যবেক্ষণ; এগুলো কখনো বরাদ্দের সীমার সঙ্গে যোগ করা হয় না।

workspace-iam:projectSaved.ko: 요청한 프로젝트 한도가 네이티브 재조회로 검증되었습니다. 다시 편집하기 전에 현재 관측값을 불러오세요.
workspace-iam:projectSaved.en: The requested project limits passed native readback. Reload current observations before another edit.
workspace-iam:projectSaved.ja: 要求したプロジェクト上限をネイティブ再読み取りで検証しました。次の編集前に現在の観測値を再読み込みしてください。
workspace-iam:projectSaved.zh-CN: 请求的项目限额已通过原生回读验证。再次编辑前，请重新加载当前观测值。
workspace-iam:projectSaved.sw: Vikomo vya mradi vilivyoombwa vimethibitishwa kwa kusoma tena kutoka huduma asilia. Pakia upya taarifa za sasa zilizoonekana kabla ya kuhariri tena.
workspace-iam:projectSaved.nb: De forespurte prosjektgrensene ble verifisert ved tilbakelesing fra de underliggende tjenestene. Last inn gjeldende observasjoner på nytt før du redigerer igjen.
workspace-iam:projectSaved.ms: Had projek yang diminta telah disahkan melalui bacaan semula asli. Muat semula pemerhatian semasa sebelum menyunting lagi.
workspace-iam:projectSaved.vi: Các hạn mức dự án được yêu cầu đã được xác minh bằng cách đọc lại từ dịch vụ gốc. Hãy tải lại dữ liệu quan sát hiện tại trước khi chỉnh sửa tiếp.
workspace-iam:projectSaved.bn: অনুরোধ করা প্রকল্পের সীমা নেটিভ পরিষেবা থেকে পুনরায় পড়ে যাচাই করা হয়েছে। আবার সম্পাদনার আগে বর্তমান পর্যবেক্ষণ লোড করুন।

workspace-iam:quotas.sw: Viwango vya mgao na mgao uliotolewa

workspace-iam:reconcile.ja: 現在のネイティブ上限を照合
workspace-iam:reconcile.sw: Patanisha vikomo vya sasa vya huduma asilia
workspace-iam:reconcile.nb: Avstem gjeldende grenser i underliggende tjenester
workspace-iam:reconcile.vi: Đối soát hạn mức hiện tại của dịch vụ gốc

workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.ko: 원래 네이티브 호출이 모두 종료되었는지 먼저 별도로 확인하세요. 이 작업은 현재 한도를 읽고 작업 차단을 해제하며 네이티브 변경을 재시도하거나 원래 요청 결과를 보장하지 않습니다.
workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.en: First independently confirm the original native calls are no longer running. This action reads current limits and resolves the operation fence; it does not retry native writes or guarantee the original requested result.
workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.ja: 元のネイティブ呼び出しがすべて終了したことを先に別途確認してください。この操作は現在の上限を読み取って操作のブロックを解除します。ネイティブ変更の再試行や元の要求結果の保証は行いません。
workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.zh-CN: 首先独立确认所有原始原生调用均已结束。此操作读取当前限额并解除操作阻止，不重试原生写入，也不保证原始请求的结果。
workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.sw: Kwanza thibitisha kwa kujitegemea kwamba miito ya awali ya huduma asilia haiendelei tena. Kitendo hiki husoma vikomo vya sasa na kuondoa kizuizi cha operesheni; hakirudii uandikaji katika huduma asilia wala kuhakikisha matokeo yaliyoombwa awali.
workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.nb: Bekreft først uavhengig at de opprinnelige kallene til de underliggende tjenestene ikke lenger kjører. Denne handlingen leser gjeldende grenser og opphever operasjonssperren. Den gjentar ikke skriveoperasjoner til de underliggende tjenestene og garanterer ikke det opprinnelig forespurte resultatet.
workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.ms: Sahkan terlebih dahulu secara berasingan bahawa semua panggilan asli asal telah berhenti berjalan. Tindakan ini membaca had semasa dan melepaskan sekatan operasi; ia tidak mencuba semula perubahan asli atau menjamin hasil yang diminta pada asalnya.
workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.vi: Trước tiên, hãy xác nhận độc lập rằng các lời gọi dịch vụ gốc ban đầu không còn chạy. Thao tác này đọc hạn mức hiện tại và gỡ chặn thao tác; không thử ghi lại vào dịch vụ gốc hay bảo đảm kết quả được yêu cầu ban đầu.
workspace-iam:reconcileHelp.bn: প্রথমে স্বতন্ত্রভাবে নিশ্চিত করুন যে মূল নেটিভ কলগুলোর কোনোটিই আর চলছে না। এই কাজ বর্তমান সীমা পড়ে এবং কার্যক্রমের বাধা সরিয়ে দেয়; এটি নেটিভ পরিবর্তন পুনরায় চালায় না বা মূল অনুরোধের কাঙ্ক্ষিত ফলাফলের নিশ্চয়তা দেয় না।

workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.ko: 원래 요청이 아닌 현재 네이티브 한도를 기록했습니다. 예산과 작업 상태를 새로 불러와 확인하세요.
workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.en: Reconciliation recorded current native limits, not the original request. Reload to inspect the resulting budget and operation state.
workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.ja: 元の要求ではなく現在のネイティブ上限を記録しました。予算と操作の状態を再読み込みして確認してください。
workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.zh-CN: 已记录当前原生限额，而非原始请求。请重新加载并检查预算及操作状态。
workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.sw: Upatanishaji umerekodi vikomo vya sasa vya huduma asilia, si ombi la awali. Pakia upya ili kukagua bajeti na hali ya operesheni iliyotokana na hatua hiyo.
workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.nb: Avstemmingen registrerte gjeldende grenser i de underliggende tjenestene, ikke den opprinnelige forespørselen. Last inn på nytt for å undersøke budsjettet og operasjonsstatusen etter avstemmingen.
workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.ms: Penyelarasan merekodkan had asli semasa, bukan permintaan asal. Muat semula untuk memeriksa belanjawan dan status operasi yang terhasil.
workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.vi: Đối soát đã ghi nhận hạn mức hiện tại của dịch vụ gốc, không phải yêu cầu ban đầu. Hãy tải lại để kiểm tra ngân sách và trạng thái thao tác sau đối soát.
workspace-iam:reconciledOutcome.bn: সমন্বয়ে মূল অনুরোধ নয়, বর্তমান নেটিভ সীমা নথিভুক্ত করা হয়েছে। এর ফলে বাজেট ও কার্যক্রমের যে অবস্থা হয়েছে তা দেখতে আবার লোড করুন।

workspace-iam:reload.vi: Tải lại dữ liệu quan sát

workspace-iam:reloadRequired.ko: 관측값을 다시 불러올 때까지 편집을 중지합니다. 새로 불러오기는 읽기만 수행하고 제출한 초안을 버리며 변경 요청을 재시도하지 않습니다.
workspace-iam:reloadRequired.en: Editing is paused until you reload observations. Reload performs reads only and discards the submitted draft; it never retries a mutation.
workspace-iam:reloadRequired.ja: 観測値を再読み込みするまで編集を停止します。再読み込みは読み取りのみを行い、送信済みの下書きを破棄します。変更要求は再試行しません。
workspace-iam:reloadRequired.zh-CN: 编辑已暂停，直到重新加载观测值。重新加载只执行读取并丢弃已提交的草稿，绝不重试变更请求。
workspace-iam:reloadRequired.sw: Uhariri umesitishwa hadi upakie upya taarifa zilizoonekana. Kupakia upya husoma tu na huondoa rasimu iliyowasilishwa; hakurudii kamwe ombi la mabadiliko.
workspace-iam:reloadRequired.nb: Redigering er satt på pause til du laster inn observasjonene på nytt. Ny innlasting utfører bare lesinger og forkaster det innsendte utkastet. Den forsøker aldri en endring på nytt.
workspace-iam:reloadRequired.ms: Penyuntingan dijeda sehingga anda memuat semula pemerhatian. Muat semula hanya membaca data dan membuang draf yang telah dihantar; ia tidak sekali-kali mencuba semula permintaan perubahan.
workspace-iam:reloadRequired.vi: Tạm dừng chỉnh sửa cho đến khi bạn tải lại dữ liệu quan sát. Tải lại chỉ thực hiện đọc và loại bỏ bản nháp đã gửi; không bao giờ thử lại thao tác thay đổi.
workspace-iam:reloadRequired.bn: পর্যবেক্ষণ আবার লোড না করা পর্যন্ত সম্পাদনা স্থগিত থাকবে। পুনরায় লোড শুধু তথ্য পড়ে এবং জমা দেওয়া খসড়া বাতিল করে; এটি কখনো পরিবর্তনের অনুরোধ পুনরায় চালায় না।

workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.ko: 응답 범위가 현재 워크스페이스와 다릅니다. 다시 인증한 뒤 새로 불러오세요.
workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.en: The returned scope does not match this workspace. Reload after re-authenticating.
workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.ja: 応答のスコープが現在のワークスペースと異なります。再認証してから再読み込みしてください。
workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.zh-CN: 返回的范围与当前工作区不符。请重新认证后再加载。
workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.sw: Wigo uliorejeshwa haulingani na eneo hili la kazi. Pakia upya baada ya kuthibitisha utambulisho tena.
workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.nb: Det returnerte tilgangsomfanget samsvarer ikke med dette arbeidsområdet. Logg inn på nytt og last inn på nytt.
workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.ms: Skop yang dikembalikan tidak sepadan dengan ruang kerja ini. Muat semula selepas membuat pengesahan identiti semula.
workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.vi: Phạm vi trả về không khớp với không gian làm việc này. Hãy tải lại sau khi xác thực lại.
workspace-iam:scopeMismatch.bn: ফেরত পাওয়া পরিধি এই ওয়ার্কস্পেসের সঙ্গে মেলে না। আবার প্রমাণীকরণ করে পুনরায় লোড করুন।

workspace-iam:settledConfirm.ko: 원래 네이티브 호출이 모두 종료되었음을 확인했습니다.
workspace-iam:settledConfirm.en: I have confirmed that every original native call has settled.
workspace-iam:settledConfirm.ja: 元のネイティブ呼び出しがすべて終了したことを確認しました。
workspace-iam:settledConfirm.zh-CN: 我已确认所有原始原生调用均已结束。
workspace-iam:settledConfirm.sw: Nimethibitisha kwamba kila mwito wa awali wa huduma asilia umekamilika.
workspace-iam:settledConfirm.nb: Jeg har bekreftet at alle de opprinnelige kallene til de underliggende tjenestene er avsluttet.
workspace-iam:settledConfirm.ms: Saya telah mengesahkan bahawa setiap panggilan asli asal telah selesai.
workspace-iam:settledConfirm.vi: Tôi đã xác nhận mọi lời gọi dịch vụ gốc ban đầu đều đã kết thúc.
workspace-iam:settledConfirm.bn: আমি নিশ্চিত করেছি যে মূল নেটিভ কলগুলোর প্রতিটি শেষ হয়েছে।

workspace-iam:unattributed.sw: Taarifa ya umiliki wa mtumiaji haipatikani
workspace-iam:unattributed.vi: Chưa xác định được người dùng sở hữu

workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.ko: 최종 결과가 확인되지 않았습니다. 실패해도 변경이 없었다는 뜻은 아닙니다. 정책과 영구 작업 기록을 새로 불러오고 요청을 재실행하지 마세요.
workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.en: The operation's final outcome is not established here. A failure does not prove nothing changed. Reload the policy and durable operations; do not replay the request.
workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.ja: 最終結果はここでは確認できません。失敗は変更がなかったことを意味しません。ポリシーと永続操作記録を再読み込みし、要求を再実行しないでください。
workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.zh-CN: 此处无法确定最终结果。失败不代表没有发生变更。请重新加载策略和持久操作记录，不要重放请求。
workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.sw: Matokeo ya mwisho ya operesheni hayajathibitishwa hapa. Kushindwa hakuthibitishi kwamba hakuna kilichobadilika. Pakia upya sera na operesheni zenye rekodi za kudumu; usirudie ombi.
workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.nb: Operasjonens endelige utfall er ikke fastslått her. En feil beviser ikke at ingenting ble endret. Last inn policyen og de varig lagrede operasjonene på nytt. Ikke gjenta forespørselen.
workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.ms: Hasil akhir operasi belum dapat dipastikan di sini. Kegagalan tidak membuktikan bahawa tiada perubahan berlaku. Muat semula dasar dan rekod operasi kekal; jangan laksanakan semula permintaan itu.
workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.vi: Chưa xác định được kết quả cuối cùng của thao tác tại đây. Lỗi không chứng minh rằng chưa có gì thay đổi. Hãy tải lại chính sách và các thao tác đã lưu bền vững; không gửi lại yêu cầu.
workspace-iam:unknownOutcome.bn: কার্যক্রমটির চূড়ান্ত ফলাফল এখানে নিশ্চিত করা যায়নি। ব্যর্থতা মানেই কোনো পরিবর্তন হয়নি, তা নয়। নীতি ও স্থায়ী কার্যক্রমের নথি আবার লোড করুন; অনুরোধটি পুনরায় চালাবেন না।

workspace-iam:unknownService.ko: 이 서비스의 할당량을 관측할 수 없습니다. 알 수 없음은 0이 아니며 편집이 차단됩니다.
workspace-iam:unknownService.en: This service's quota observation is unavailable. Unknown is not zero; editing is blocked.
workspace-iam:unknownService.ja: このサービスのクォータを観測できません。不明はゼロではなく、編集はブロックされます。
workspace-iam:unknownService.zh-CN: 无法观测此服务的配额。未知不代表零，编辑已阻止。
workspace-iam:unknownService.sw: Taarifa za kiwango cha mgao wa huduma hii hazipatikani. Kutojulikana si sifuri; uhariri umezuiwa.
workspace-iam:unknownService.nb: Kvotene for denne tjenesten kan ikke observeres. Ukjent er ikke null. Redigering er blokkert.
workspace-iam:unknownService.ms: Pemerhatian kuota perkhidmatan ini tidak tersedia. Nilai yang tidak diketahui bukan sifar; penyuntingan disekat.
workspace-iam:unknownService.vi: Không thể quan sát hạn ngạch của dịch vụ này. Chưa rõ không có nghĩa là bằng không; việc chỉnh sửa bị chặn.
workspace-iam:unknownService.bn: এই পরিষেবার কোটা পর্যবেক্ষণ পাওয়া যাচ্ছে না। অজানা মান শূন্য নয়; সম্পাদনা বন্ধ রাখা হয়েছে।

workspace-iam:unsupported.vi: Không được hỗ trợ / không được cung cấp

workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.ko: 사용자 행은 네이티브 사용자 소유자가 명시된 리소스만 표시합니다. 프로젝트 구성원이라는 이유로 리소스 소유권을 부여하지 않습니다. 네이티브 프로젝트 할당량을 사용자별 할당량으로 조회하거나 표시하지 않습니다.
workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.en: User rows show only resources with an explicit native user owner. Project membership does not imply resource ownership. Native project quotas are never queried or presented as per-user quotas.
workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.ja: ユーザー行はネイティブのユーザー所有者が明示されたリソースのみを表示します。プロジェクトへの参加はリソースの所有を意味しません。ネイティブのプロジェクトクォータをユーザー別クォータとして照会・表示しません。
workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.zh-CN: 用户行仅显示明确包含原生用户所有者的资源。项目成员身份不代表资源所有权。绝不将原生项目配额作为用户配额查询或显示。
workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.sw: Safu mlalo za watumiaji huonyesha tu rasilimali zenye mmiliki wa mtumiaji aliyebainishwa wazi katika huduma asilia. Uanachama wa mradi haumaanishi umiliki wa rasilimali. Viwango asilia vya mgao wa miradi haviulizwi wala kuwasilishwa kamwe kama viwango vya mgao kwa kila mtumiaji.
workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.nb: Brukerrader viser bare ressurser med en eksplisitt registrert brukereier i den underliggende tjenesten. Prosjektmedlemskap innebærer ikke ressurseierskap. Prosjektkvoter fra de underliggende tjenestene hentes aldri inn eller presenteres som kvoter per bruker.
workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.ms: Baris pengguna hanya menunjukkan sumber yang mempunyai pemilik pengguna asli yang dinyatakan secara jelas. Keahlian projek tidak bermakna pemilikan sumber. Kuota projek asli tidak sekali-kali ditanya atau dipaparkan sebagai kuota setiap pengguna.
workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.vi: Các dòng người dùng chỉ hiển thị tài nguyên có chủ sở hữu người dùng được dịch vụ gốc ghi rõ. Tư cách thành viên dự án không đồng nghĩa với quyền sở hữu tài nguyên. Hạn ngạch dự án của dịch vụ gốc không bao giờ được truy vấn hay trình bày như hạn ngạch theo người dùng.
workspace-iam:userQuotaHelp.bn: ব্যবহারকারীর সারিতে শুধু সেই রিসোর্স দেখানো হয় যার নেটিভ ব্যবহারকারী-মালিক স্পষ্টভাবে নির্ধারিত। প্রকল্পের সদস্য হওয়া রিসোর্সের মালিকানা বোঝায় না। নেটিভ প্রকল্পের কোটা কখনো ব্যবহারকারীভিত্তিক কোটা হিসেবে অনুসন্ধান বা উপস্থাপন করা হয় না।

workspace-selector:browseHelp.ko: 도메인을 둘러봐도 현재 세션은 바뀌지 않습니다. 프로젝트를 선택하면 도메인과 프로젝트가 함께 전환됩니다.
workspace-selector:browseHelp.en: Browsing a domain does not change your active session. Select a project to switch both together.
workspace-selector:browseHelp.ja: ドメインの閲覧では現在のセッションは変わりません。プロジェクトを選択すると両方が同時に切り替わります。
workspace-selector:browseHelp.zh-CN: 浏览域不会更改当前会话。选择项目后，域和项目将同时切换。
workspace-selector:browseHelp.sw: Kuvinjari kikoa hakubadilishi kipindi chako kinachotumika. Chagua mradi ili kuvibadilisha vyote pamoja.
workspace-selector:browseHelp.nb: Når du blar i et domene, endres ikke den aktive økten. Velg et prosjekt for å bytte begge samtidig.
workspace-selector:browseHelp.ms: Melayari domain tidak mengubah sesi aktif anda. Pilih projek untuk menukar domain dan projek bersama-sama.
workspace-selector:browseHelp.vi: Việc duyệt một miền không thay đổi phiên đang hoạt động. Chọn dự án để chuyển cả miền và dự án cùng lúc.
workspace-selector:browseHelp.bn: কোনো ডোমেনের সংস্থান দেখলে আপনার সক্রিয় সেশন পরিবর্তিত হয় না। ডোমেন ও প্রকল্প একসঙ্গে পরিবর্তন করতে একটি প্রকল্প নির্বাচন করুন।

workspace-selector:continue.ja: 現在のワークスペースで続行
workspace-selector:continue.sw: Endelea na eneo la kazi linalotumika
workspace-selector:continue.vi: Tiếp tục với không gian làm việc đang hoạt động
workspace-selector:continue.bn: সক্রিয় কাজের পরিসর নিয়ে এগিয়ে যান

workspace-selector:createDenied.ko: 현재 이 도메인에 프로젝트를 생성할 권한이 없습니다.
workspace-selector:createDenied.en: You do not currently have permission to create projects in this domain.
workspace-selector:createDenied.ja: 現在、このドメインでプロジェクトを作成する権限がありません。
workspace-selector:createDenied.zh-CN: 您目前无权在此域中创建项目。
workspace-selector:createDenied.sw: Kwa sasa huna ruhusa ya kuunda miradi katika kikoa hiki.
workspace-selector:createDenied.nb: Du har for øyeblikket ikke tillatelse til å opprette prosjekter i dette domenet.
workspace-selector:createDenied.ms: Anda kini tidak mempunyai kebenaran untuk mencipta projek dalam domain ini.
workspace-selector:createDenied.vi: Hiện bạn không có quyền tạo dự án trong miền này.
workspace-selector:createDenied.bn: এই ডোমেনে প্রকল্প তৈরি করার অনুমতি বর্তমানে আপনার নেই।

workspace-selector:createRejected.ko: 생성이 거부되었습니다. 입력과 현재 권한을 확인한 뒤 다시 제출하세요.
workspace-selector:createRejected.en: Creation was rejected. Check your input and current permissions before submitting again.
workspace-selector:createRejected.ja: 作成が拒否されました。入力と現在の権限を確認してから再送信してください。
workspace-selector:createRejected.zh-CN: 创建被拒绝。请检查输入和当前权限后再提交。
workspace-selector:createRejected.sw: Uundaji umekataliwa. Angalia ingizo lako na ruhusa za sasa kabla ya kuwasilisha tena.
workspace-selector:createRejected.nb: Opprettingen ble avvist. Kontroller inndataene og gjeldende tillatelser før du sender inn på nytt.
workspace-selector:createRejected.ms: Penciptaan ditolak. Semak input dan kebenaran semasa anda sebelum menghantar semula.
workspace-selector:createRejected.vi: Yêu cầu tạo đã bị từ chối. Hãy kiểm tra thông tin đã nhập và quyền hiện tại trước khi gửi lại.
workspace-selector:createRejected.bn: তৈরির অনুরোধ প্রত্যাখ্যান করা হয়েছে। আবার জমা দেওয়ার আগে আপনার ইনপুট ও বর্তমান অনুমতি যাচাই করুন।

workspace-selector:createUncertain.ko: 생성 결과를 확인하지 못했습니다. 다시 제출하지 마세요. 양식을 닫고 목록을 새로고침하여 리소스를 확인하세요.
workspace-selector:createUncertain.en: The creation outcome is unknown. Do not submit again. Close this form and refresh inventory to check for the resource.
workspace-selector:createUncertain.ja: 作成結果が不明です。再送信せず、フォームを閉じて一覧を更新し、リソースを確認してください。
workspace-selector:createUncertain.zh-CN: 创建结果未知。请勿再次提交。请关闭表单并刷新列表以检查资源。
workspace-selector:createUncertain.sw: Matokeo ya uundaji hayajulikani. Usiwasilishe tena. Funga fomu hii na uonyeshe upya orodha ili kukagua rasilimali.
workspace-selector:createUncertain.nb: Utfallet av opprettingen er ukjent. Ikke send inn på nytt. Lukk dette skjemaet og oppdater ressursoversikten for å se om ressursen finnes.
workspace-selector:createUncertain.ms: Hasil penciptaan tidak diketahui. Jangan hantar semula. Tutup borang ini dan muat semula inventori untuk memeriksa sama ada sumber tersebut wujud.
workspace-selector:createUncertain.vi: Chưa xác định được kết quả tạo. Không gửi lại yêu cầu. Hãy đóng biểu mẫu này và làm mới danh sách để kiểm tra xem tài nguyên đã tồn tại hay chưa.
workspace-selector:createUncertain.bn: তৈরির ফলাফল জানা যায়নি। আবার জমা দেবেন না। এই ফর্ম বন্ধ করে সংস্থানতালিকা রিফ্রেশ করে সংস্থানটি আছে কি না দেখুন।

workspace-selector:domainSearch.ja: ドメイン名またはIDを検索
workspace-selector:domainSearch.sw: Tafuta jina au ID ya kikoa
workspace-selector:domainSearch.vi: Tìm theo tên hoặc ID miền
workspace-selector:domainSearch.bn: ডোমেনের নাম বা ID দিয়ে খুঁজুন

workspace-selector:empty.ko: 일치하는 접근 가능한 프로젝트가 없습니다. 전체 보기, 검색어 변경 또는 표시 설정에서 숨긴 리소스 복구를 시도하세요.
workspace-selector:empty.en: No matching authorized projects. Try All, change your search, or recover hidden resources in display settings.
workspace-selector:empty.ja: 一致するアクセス可能なプロジェクトがありません。すべての表示、検索条件の変更、または表示設定で非表示リソースを復元してください。
workspace-selector:empty.zh-CN: 没有匹配的可访问项目。请尝试查看全部、更改搜索条件，或在显示设置中恢复隐藏资源。
workspace-selector:empty.sw: Hakuna miradi inayolingana yenye ruhusa. Jaribu Zote, badilisha utafutaji wako, au rejesha rasilimali zilizofichwa katika mipangilio ya mwonekano.
workspace-selector:empty.nb: Ingen samsvarende prosjekter du har tilgang til. Prøv Alle, endre søket eller hent frem skjulte ressurser i visningsinnstillingene.
workspace-selector:empty.ms: Tiada projek sepadan yang boleh diakses. Cuba paparan Semua, ubah carian anda atau pulihkan sumber tersembunyi dalam tetapan paparan.
workspace-selector:empty.vi: Không có dự án được phép truy cập nào phù hợp. Hãy thử Tất cả, thay đổi nội dung tìm kiếm hoặc khôi phục tài nguyên đã ẩn trong cài đặt hiển thị.
workspace-selector:empty.bn: মিলে যায় এমন অনুমোদিত কোনো প্রকল্প নেই। সব প্রকল্প দেখুন, অনুসন্ধান পরিবর্তন করুন অথবা প্রদর্শন সেটিংসে লুকানো সংস্থান ফিরিয়ে আনুন।

workspace-selector:loadFailed.ko: 현재 리소스 접근 권한을 확인하지 못했습니다. 선택하거나 생성하기 전에 목록을 새로고침하세요.
workspace-selector:loadFailed.en: Could not verify current resource access. Refresh inventory before selecting or creating resources.
workspace-selector:loadFailed.ja: 現在のアクセス権を確認できませんでした。選択や作成の前に一覧を更新してください。
workspace-selector:loadFailed.zh-CN: 无法验证当前资源访问权限。请选择或创建资源前先刷新列表。
workspace-selector:loadFailed.sw: Haikuweza kuthibitisha ufikiaji wa sasa wa rasilimali. Onyesha upya orodha kabla ya kuchagua au kuunda rasilimali.
workspace-selector:loadFailed.nb: Kunne ikke bekrefte gjeldende ressurstilgang. Oppdater ressursoversikten før du velger eller oppretter ressurser.
workspace-selector:loadFailed.ms: Tidak dapat mengesahkan akses sumber semasa. Muat semula inventori sebelum memilih atau mencipta sumber.
workspace-selector:loadFailed.vi: Không thể xác minh quyền truy cập tài nguyên hiện tại. Hãy làm mới danh sách trước khi chọn hoặc tạo tài nguyên.
workspace-selector:loadFailed.bn: সংস্থানে বর্তমান অ্যাক্সেস যাচাই করা যায়নি। সংস্থান নির্বাচন বা তৈরি করার আগে সংস্থানতালিকা রিফ্রেশ করুন।

workspace-selector:personalProjectNameHe.ms: Nama projek peribadi dijana secara automatik.

workspace-selector:personalProjectNameHe.bn: ব্যক্তিগত প্রকল্পের নাম স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে তৈরি হয়।

workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.ko: 고정, 순서, 숨김, 최근 선택은 이 브라우저에서 계정과 인증 도메인별로만 저장됩니다. 접근 권한에는 영향을 주지 않습니다. 숨긴 리소스는 여기서 복구할 수 있으며 활성 범위는 항상 표시됩니다. 이동 버튼은 표시된 결과의 순서를 바꿉니다.
workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.en: Pins, ordering, hidden items and recent selections are saved only in this browser for your account and identity domain. They never grant access. Hidden resources remain available here; the active scope always stays visible. Move controls reorder the displayed results.
workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.ja: 固定、順序、非表示、最近の選択は、このブラウザーでアカウントと認証ドメイン別に保存されます。アクセス権には影響しません。非表示リソースはここで復元でき、現在の範囲は常に表示されます。移動ボタンは表示中の結果を並べ替えます。
workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.zh-CN: 固定、排序、隐藏和最近选择仅按账户与身份域保存在此浏览器中，不会授予访问权限。隐藏的资源可在此恢复，当前范围始终可见。移动按钮调整当前显示结果的顺序。
workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.sw: Vipengee vilivyobandikwa, mpangilio, vipengee vilivyofichwa na chaguo za hivi karibuni huhifadhiwa katika kivinjari hiki pekee kwa akaunti yako na kikoa cha utambulisho. Havitoi ufikiaji kamwe. Rasilimali zilizofichwa zinaendelea kupatikana hapa; wigo unaotumika hubaki ukionekana kila wakati. Vidhibiti vya kusogeza hupanga upya matokeo yanayoonyeshwa.
workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.nb: Festede elementer, rekkefølge, skjulte elementer og nylige valg lagres bare i denne nettleseren for kontoen og identitetsdomenet ditt. De gir aldri tilgang. Skjulte ressurser er fortsatt tilgjengelige her. Det aktive tilgangsomfanget forblir alltid synlig. Flytteknappene endrer rekkefølgen på de viste resultatene.
workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.ms: Sematan, susunan, item tersembunyi dan pilihan terkini hanya disimpan dalam pelayar ini untuk akaun dan domain asal identiti anda. Tetapan ini tidak sekali-kali memberikan akses. Sumber tersembunyi boleh dipulihkan di sini; skop aktif sentiasa kelihatan. Kawalan alih mengubah susunan hasil yang dipaparkan.
workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.vi: Các mục đã ghim, thứ tự, mục đã ẩn và lựa chọn gần đây chỉ được lưu trong trình duyệt này cho tài khoản và miền danh tính của bạn. Các tùy chọn này không cấp quyền truy cập. Tài nguyên đã ẩn vẫn có thể truy cập tại đây; phạm vi đang hoạt động luôn được hiển thị. Các nút di chuyển thay đổi thứ tự kết quả đang hiển thị.
workspace-selector:preferencesHelp.bn: পিন, ক্রম, লুকানো আইটেম ও সাম্প্রতিক নির্বাচন শুধু এই ব্রাউজারে আপনার অ্যাকাউন্ট ও পরিচয় ডোমেন অনুযায়ী সংরক্ষিত হয়। এগুলো কখনো অ্যাক্সেসের অনুমতি দেয় না। লুকানো সংস্থান এখান থেকে পাওয়া যায়; সক্রিয় পরিসর সবসময় দৃশ্যমান থাকে। সরানোর নিয়ন্ত্রণগুলো প্রদর্শিত ফলাফলের ক্রম বদলায়।

workspace-selector:storageFailed.nb: Nettleserlagringen er utilgjengelig. Visningsendringer gjelder bare mens denne velgeren er åpen.
workspace-selector:storageFailed.ms: Storan pelayar tidak tersedia. Perubahan paparan hanya terpakai selagi pemilih ini kekal terbuka.
workspace-selector:storageFailed.vi: Bộ nhớ lưu trữ của trình duyệt không khả dụng. Thay đổi hiển thị chỉ có hiệu lực khi bộ chọn này còn mở.
workspace-selector:storageFailed.bn: ব্রাউজারের সংরক্ষণাগার ব্যবহার করা যাচ্ছে না। এই নির্বাচনকারী খোলা থাকা পর্যন্তই প্রদর্শনের পরিবর্তনগুলো কার্যকর থাকবে।
